author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: WhatsApp patched three security flaws, including one exploited in a real scam campaign to make fraudulent messages appear more credible. WhatsApp’s November security advisory fixes three flaws, including CVE-2026-23871, a vulnerability in Click to WhatsApp ads affecting WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business for Android versions earlier than 2.26.17.4. “Incomplete validation of external ad-reply URLs in WhatsApp […]
title: CVE-2026-23871: WhatsApp Bug Helped Scammers Make Messages Look Legitimate

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard disclose third-party data breaches after the N0n extortion group claims to have stolen customer information. The disclosures involving JPMorgan Chase, Visa and Mastercard highlight a familiar but often underestimated security problem: the risks introduced by third-party service providers. All three companies have confirmed incidents involving external vendors after the N0n extortion […]
title: JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard Report Third-Party Data Breaches After N0n Claims

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Cisco Expressway flaw CVE-2026-76466 is being exploited to gain root access and move from exposed devices into internal networks. Attackers have exploited a critical flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-76466 (CVSS score of 9.8) in Cisco Expressway to breach a Russian organization, and they moved fast once a working exploit went public. “A vulnerability in the database […]
title: Hackers Exploit Cisco Expressway Flaw CVE-2026-76466 to Breach Russian Organization

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Trump fired his national cyber director days after outages hit Microsoft, US flights, and the NSA’s classified network. No link to a cyberattack confirmed. The White House fired national cyber director Sean Cairncross, a person close to the administration told Reuters. It’s the first major personnel move since a string of tech failures hit the […]
title: Trump’s First Move After the Outages: Fire the Cyber Director

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Hunt.io uncovered a credential-stealing operation that compromised 603 PCs and exposed bank, government and password manager accounts. Hunt.io found an exposed open directory sitting on a Netherlands VPS, and inside it was the live loot store of a credential-theft operation. The report describes decrypted password-manager vaults, cleartext bank logins, and accounts behind the federal identity […]
title: Hunt.io Uncovers Russian-Speaking Credential Theft Operation Targeting US Banks and Government Accounts
